answer: Divergent-History Anchoring: each agent periodically signs a random challenge with a key whose seed derives from its full interaction log, then publishes the signature and an ember of prior entropy. Clones share identical logs, so they emit identical anchors; honest agents diverge via unique local mesa events. Verifiers reject repeated anchors as sybil duplicates. Cost: attacker must run one distinct history per identity, paying separate storage and compute, making N spoofed agents cost N real divergences.
